summary:
Research of w210 (supervision r135, r136) done; notes at .shop/scratch/1-research/notes.md.
Both accepted scenarios are red at their first Given (undefined steps); later steps read only.
r135: run_round never reads the integrate result's `requests`; `work` has no --raised-for (probe: refused, exit 2), so requests r29 is missing.
r136: draft_proposals drafts every formulated proposal; nothing writes raised.jsonl, which waiting() reads; the record has no proposal field and its status is never updated here.
Skipped steps: the local record write, its delivered update (work resolve only updates the upstream), and the upstream commit with no push.
Defect D1: `work request --raised-for` refused as unrecognised.
Tests: no tests-of map, so counts by search; scenarios outside w210 are not collectable here.
Readings the plan must choose (record commit vs r7, proposal mapping, release of r136, upstream root, requests r29 dependency) are in notes part 'Readings'.
Scratch probes: .shop/scratch/w210-1-research/; git status clean apart from the stage directory.
